Image 1 is the edit target, Emo portrait v1; images 2-5 are approved tight pixel-art portrait style references. Make the ONE necessary corrective revision to image 1 and preserve its identity: mid-forties male lining artisan, warm brown skin, dark chunky curls, little beige linen cap, slim angular clean-shaven face and long characteristic nose, blue-gray work collar and dark apron. Style: hard-edged large square clusters at 74-by-100 target resolution, strongly designed large angular facial color planes. Only a few broad curl masses, no individual strands. Muted earth colors with about 24-32 colors overall and 4 clear flesh values. No gradients, dithering, blur, painterly softness, airbrush, skin flecks, broken pixel noise, shiny anime eyes. Keep the original portrait's subdued work clothes, cap and hair colors. Whole face dominates frame; complete cap, curls, ears and jaw with safe transparent margins.
One head only, 74:100 tall aspect, no text, no frame, no props, no other people. Preserve genuine transparent background. This is a close-up portrait, not a head-and-shoulders bust.
